empirical_result.statement: Third frontier has 568 verified rows, 883 new columns, full rational rank 832; exact induced increments are 11 on the previous 657 columns, 1 on the first 245, and 0 on original 117.

missing_geometric_bridge: Formalize the X0(11) finite-field points and Hecke incidence so the saved rows are proved to equal their mathematical correspondences.

positive_structural_theorem.conclusion: A w is an old-only relation generated by the expanded system but is outside the old row space S.
positive_structural_theorem.hypotheses: Additive groups O,N,W; old-only set S contains zero; additive maps A:W to O and B:W to N; a row combination w has B w=0 and A w outside S.
positive_structural_theorem.instance_bridge: Thirteen exact third-layer closed combinations and their images are saved; eleven images add rank modulo previous rows, one reaches first-layer rows. Their finite coefficient equality and independence are checked in Python, not Lean.

zero_structural_theorem.conclusion: The enlarged old-only relation set equals S.
zero_structural_theorem.hypotheses: The old-only set S is closed under addition; every closed new-row combination maps into S.
zero_structural_theorem.instance_bridge: Two exact combinations reach the original boundary and both images lie in the original row span; finite matrix checks remain computational.
